ns2:section.sectionText: " Restricted to College of ACES until July 2, 2021, with many seats reserved for new ACES freshmen in June. This section has a blended format in which part of the content is delivered in lecture and discussion, and part is delivered online. Some seats are reserved for ACES students; any remaining seats will be released during business hours on the Friday before fall classes begin. This course has a recommended placement score of 65%. For details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS. This class has combined evening exams on September 23, October 21, and November 18."
